title: Hadiya Mich
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Hadiya Mich — a thick barley and vegetable porridge from the Hadiya people of central southern Ethiopia. Spiced with black pepper and served with buttermilk. The everyday meal that sustained the agricultural Hadiya community.
longDesc: The Hadiya people cultivate barley and sorghum in the highlands south of Hosanna. Mich is their traditional thick barley porridge, enriched with vegetables and served with fresh buttermilk — a complete meal from the agricultural tradition.
steps: Cook carrot and potato in water until soft.
chefTips: The buttermilk is not optional — it is the Hadiya tradition.
culturalNote: Hadiya Mich is the food of the barley fields — the simple, nourishing porridge of an agricultural people who have cultivated their highland farms for centuries.
